licensing_decision.approved_artifact_representation: Project-authored synthetic values and concise attributed facts only; S1/S4/S5 source bytes, full tables, figures, input decks, nuclear data, and source-result payloads remain external.
licensing_decision.permission_required_for: Any source-figure digitization, full table redistribution, raw input/output bundle, or external solver reproduction package.

calibration_policy.objective: Make a deterministic synthetic fixture close to reported aggregate values without claiming that an external DRAGON5/DONJON5 run was reproduced.
calibration_policy.k_effective_method: Minimax midpoint of the two printed S4 lattice values; the printed pair is preserved and no new acceptance tolerance is selected.
calibration_policy.burnup_method: Independent SI/unit conversion from the reported constant power and duration; compare against the reported rounded exit burnup.
calibration_policy.full_core_summary_method: Project-authored replay of small published aggregate targets and a deterministic schedule; it is a data-contract fixture, not a solver result.
calibration_policy.iteration_rule: Recompute all cases from the frozen definition, inspect absolute and relative differences, and retain only bounded deterministic changes. Do not tune equations, runtime constants, or tolerances.
